sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with an impressive run of five consecutive wins, travel away to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October. Alsager are struggling at the foot of the division with just one win from ten games and have lost their last five matches, making this an ideal opportunity for Sandbach to extend their winning streak and consolidate their one-point lead over second-placed Stafford Town.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town, offering a chance to close the gap on leaders Sandbach with a win, while Stafford's recent draw suggests they may be finding consistency difficult. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth face a trip to Eccleshall in what pits the league's joint-highest scorers against an improving mid-table side. Wolverhampton Casuals, in fourth place, are at home against Wednesfield Community in a relatively tight mid-table battle. Bilston Town (6th) visit Foley Meir (13th) in what should favour the in-form visitors, while struggling Shawbury United host Barnton, with Shawbury desperate to break a run of five consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash of two mid-table sides seeking momentum. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between the division's two weakest teams, while Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table affair. Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town, with Widnes in particular seeking their first win of the season after collecting just two points from seven games.
